style: Match the style of the last reference image exactly (Empress Solenne, a card from this same game): semi-realistic digital painting with fine detail and believable materials (cloth, metal, fire, skin), deep-space backgrounds full of real-looking nebulae, galaxies and star fields, soft cinematic lighting with a single warm light source glowing against cool dark space, rich but restrained colour, a calm, regal, mysterious mood. Not cartoon, not chibi, not storybook, not a movie poster or superhero line-up.
race: The four Lost Races, drawn exactly as in the first four reference images (each image shows three of one race), keeping their shapes, proportions, costumes and colours, only painted. The Nyxari: tall, thin hooded figures in deep indigo-black cloaks that fray into smoke at the hem, the hood completely empty and black inside, with only two narrow glowing pale slit eyes (no face, no mask); some with a thorn crown and an eclipse behind the head. The Korrath: short, broad, stocky smiths entirely in polished steel plate with bronze trim, a bucket helm with a glowing T-shaped visor slit, a braided copper-red beard, a forge-heart glowing orange through the chest, a dark red cape; with forge hammers, round-bossed bronze-trimmed shields, tongs and anvils. Not stone, not orcs, no exposed faces. The Seren: tall, serene astronomers in long pale white-and-silver robes whose hem is deep navy embroidered with constellations, a white hood framing a face that is a window onto deep night sky, dark navy and full of tiny stars, with closed, calm eyes (no skin, not blue-skinned), a great white crescent moon behind the head, small moons orbiting them; holding orreries, golden star-pointers or crescent-topped staves. Not blue-skinned, not elves. The Pyrr: living flames shaped like slender dancers, legs and body of red, orange and yellow fire, a mane of flame, eyes like glowing coals.
framing: Wide 16:9 landscape divided into four equal vertical panels side by side, separated by thin dark lines, like four portrait cards in a row; each panel is its own complete scene with its own backdrop. Each figure stands in the middle of its panel, head about 35% of the way down, the backdrop filling the panel to every edge. No text, no lettering, no logos, no borders around the whole picture.

cards.mode_lost_races: Four panels, left to right. 1: a Korrath smith in his forge-world, a dark iron forge hall open to space, molten metal glowing on an anvil beside him, sparks drifting up into a brown-amber nebula. 2: a Seren astronomer on a pale observatory terrace among the stars, a huge crescent moon and ringed planets behind her in a deep blue starfield, small moons orbiting her raised hand. 3: a Pyrr flame-dancer mid-step on the surface of a red giant sun, solar flares arching behind in crimson and gold. 4: a Nyxari void-stalker before a black eclipse ringed with pale violet corona, wisps of shadow drifting off their cloak into an inky purple void.
